title: Retire the global world-clock raid after measurement withdrew the re-anchoring fix
summary: check_for_raid passed origin=(0,0), target=(0,0) literally; 12/12 raiders spawned outside every region and sat inert, so it had never produced a raid. A re-anchoring fix was implemented, measured and withdrawn: 11/12 re-anchored spawns were still off-region, tactical.py:141 PANIC_RETREAT swallowed the raid with the same (0,0) literal, and in one of two worlds nothing changed at all. Retired instead, which is the hard-bug fix. Second (0,0) defect filed separately.
